fieldValues.title: Decision quality 2026-11-03: form is filled, substance is not; nothing is ever set aside
fieldValues.summary: Of 116 decisions, 110 ratified and 0 set aside. Since 10-15: rationale 97%, revisit 100%, but a case per option 41%, no alternatives 29%, precedent linked as a relation 12%, placed in a domain or boundary 5%. 49 are minutes of a ruling already made. The checks that exist run only in the agenda, as advice.
evidence: Bulk pass over records/ governance/decision, 2026-11-03 (criteria: >=2 options; >=5 words per option; relation or text citing a decision or principle; rationale >=10 words; revisit >=4 words; in-domain or boundary: tag)
clerk lib/adapters/session.mjs:126-130: a proposal from an exercise is created with title, question and statement only
clerk lib/practice/decision-options.mjs runs only in agenda.mjs:166; session.mjs:84-91 framing check is advice (e337703b)
spec counter-example: the RFC Charter Check is checker-enforced; 41 of 54 rfc-decisions cite the compass
fieldValues.body: The owner's rule: a decision presents a case for every option after reviewing past decisions and principles; no branch without a rationale. No programme template asks for the precedent search and no gate refuses a decision without a case per option. The "leads to" option format (from 10-20) is the one convention that correlates with strong records.
